query:
SELECT month AS period, subcategory AS segment, 100.0 * SUM(unit_price * unit_discount * qty) / NULLIF(SUM(unit_price * qty), 0) AS value
FROM sales_lines
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2
summary: 2 unusual run(s) for avg_discount_pct by subcategory, period 2025-Q2: Pedals 2025-04 high (peak 0.1% vs ~0.0% expected); Mountain Bikes 2025-04 high (peak 0.5% vs ~0.1% expected). No sales at all for: Bib-Shorts 2025-05, Bib-Shorts 2025-06, Bottom Brackets 2025-05, Bottom Brackets 2025-06, Brakes 2025-05, Brakes 2025-06, Chains 2025-05, Chains 2025-06
